clue.text: Bishop wants to promote cook

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
to promote someone is to raise them in rank

explanation.surface: A bishop is keen to advance the career of the kitchen cook.
explanation.definitionFit: To braise is to cook slowly in a covered pot with a little liquid, a kitchen method.

clue.text: Impudent writing, for example, in an extended sequence of notes

indicators.note: the letter for writing is placed inside the run of note letters

parts.note: B, A, E, F, A, C, E, D are all musical note names, a long string of them
R stands for one of the three Rs (reading, writing, arithmetic)

explanation.surface: Cheeky graffiti is scrawled across a long musical score.
explanation.walkthrough: The three Rs are reading, (w)riting and (a)rithmetic, so writing is an R. Every other letter of the answer is a note name from A to G.
explanation.definitionFit: Barefaced means shameless or brazen, the same as impudent behaviour done openly.

clue.text: A boy that acquired djinn, oddly

definitions.text: A boy that acquired djinn, oddly

indicators.note: the boy gains the following letters, so they are joined on after him

parts.note: a lad is a boy

indicators.note: only the odd-numbered letters of the word djinn are kept: first, third, fifth

explanation.surface: A tale about a lad who came by a genie in a strange way.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition as well: the boy in the Arabian Nights story gained a genie (djinn) from a lamp.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Arabian Nights tale the youth finds a lamp holding a genie that grants his wishes.

clue.text: Old festival is a natural riot

indicators.note: a riot is wild disorder, so the letters of the words before it are thrown about

explanation.surface: An ancient celebration is described as a natural free-for-all.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman midwinter feast honouring the god Saturn was famous for its licence and revelry.

clue.text: Green sweets are the tops

parts.note: vert is the heraldic word for green
ices are frozen desserts, served as sweets

explanation.surface: Someone declares that green-coloured confectionery is the best there is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The tops' looks like slang for excellent; here it means peaks or apexes.
explanation.definitionFit: Vertices are the highest points or apexes of shapes, the uppermost peaks.

clue.text: Group of countries' irrational fear about closure of nuclear plant

parts.note: the EU, the European Union, is a group of countries

indicators.note: the fear word goes round the following letter

parts.note: a phobia is an irrational fear

indicators.note: the closing letter of the word nuclear is taken

explanation.surface: A bloc of nations has an unreasonable dread about shutting down an atomic power station.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nuclear plant' looks like one phrase meaning a power station, but 'plant' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Euphorbia is a genus of plants, the spurges, including the poinsettia.

clue.text: Colour seen in a bird is new

indicators.note: the letter for new sits inside the bird

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird

explanation.surface: A fresh shade is spotted on a little bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A tint is a shade or hue, a pale variety of a colour.

clue.text: Before taking one of the strings, study harmony

indicators.note: the study word comes first and then takes on the string word after it

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or learn
a cord is a piece of string

explanation.surface: A musician studies before picking up one of the stringed instruments, seeking harmony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strings' suggests a section of an orchestra, but a cord is simply a string.
explanation.definitionFit: Concord is agreement or peace between people, a harmonious state.

clue.text: All that's left of building, after this hits?

definitions.text: All that's left of building, after this hits?

parts.words: All that's left of building, after this hits?
parts.note: an artillery projectile that strikes a house leaves only its hollow outer walls, and both the projectile and the gutted ruin share one name

explanation.surface: After a bombardment, only a ruin remains of a building.
explanation.definitionFit: An exploding artillery round can leave a building as a gutted frame, and both are called by this word.

clue.text: Bachelor, unreliable type, had child — that's a nuisance

parts.note: a rat is a disloyal, untrustworthy person

explanation.surface: An untrustworthy single man fathered a child, which was troublesome.
explanation.definitionFit: A brat is an annoying, badly behaved youngster.

clue.text: Chicken, perhaps, deciding upfront to abandon open car

indicators.note: the letter that follows is dropped from the car word

parts.note: a roadster is an open two-seater car

indicators.note: the front letter of the word deciding is taken

explanation.surface: Someone resolves at the outset to leave their convertible behind.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing D from ROADSTER leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A roaster is a bird, typically a chicken, of the right size for roasting.

clue.text: A few coins comprising an act of expiation

indicators.note: the coin word contains the following letters

parts.note: pence are small British coins

explanation.surface: A handful of coins are given as an act of atonement.
explanation.definitionFit: Penance is a punishment undergone to atone for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Turbulent NATO defier is Russia, for one

indicators.note: turbulent means disturbed and agitated, so the letters are stirred up

explanation.surface: Russia is described as a stormy defier of the NATO alliance.
explanation.definitionFit: Russia is formally the Russian Federation, a union of constituent republics and regions.

clue.text: Jaw from judge to creature of the night

parts.note: an owl is a nocturnal bird

explanation.surface: A judge's jaw is compared to that of a nocturnal animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A jowl is the lower jaw or the flesh hanging beneath it.

clue.text: Layabout is a broken reed during traditional Christmas

indicators.note: the shuffled letters go inside the Christmas word

parts.note: Nowell is an old spelling of Noel, Christmas, as in the carol

indicators.note: broken means the letters of reed are rearranged

explanation.surface: An idler is like a snapped reed over the festive season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' rearranges the reed's letters to EERD; 'during' sets them after the first letter of the old carol spelling of Noel.
explanation.definitionFit: A ne'er-do-well is an idle, good-for-nothing person, the same as a shiftless loafer.

clue.text: Touching state of one exposed to disease

definitions.meaning: the condition of physically touching something
in medicine, a person who has been near an infected patient

explanation.definitionFit: Contact is the condition of touching, and in medicine a contact is someone who has been near an infected person.

clue.text: A little light competition run in antiquity

parts.note: a torch is a small hand-held light
a race is a contest of speed

explanation.surface: A small lamp is used in a contest, a footrace held long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek relay in which runners passed a burning flame was a classical event.

clue.text: Heartlessly tough chasing money, to an extent

indicators.note: the tough letters follow behind the money word

parts.note: bread is slang for money

indicators.note: with its middle letters removed, only the first and last of the word tough remain

explanation.surface: A hard man pursues cash to a certain degree.
explanation.walkthrough: TOUGH without its heart is TH.
explanation.definitionFit: Breadth is width or extent, how far something reaches from side to side.

clue.text: When one needs less to drink

definitions.text: When one needs less to drink

parts.words: When one needs less to drink
parts.note: reads as a time of reduced thirst, but means a bar period when one needs less money to buy a drink, as prices are cut

explanation.surface: A time when one is less thirsty.
explanation.definitionFit: A bar's discount period means a customer needs less cash for each drink.

clue.text: File is thus taped with appropriate colour and put back

indicators.note: put back means the assembled letters are reversed
the two short words are bound inside the colour, as papers are tied with tape

parts.note: red is the fitting colour, since official papers are tied with red tape
so means thus

explanation.surface: An official file is bound in red tape and returned to its place.
explanation.walkthrough: Official papers are traditionally tied with red tape, which is why red is the 'appropriate colour'; 'put back' turns the bound result, REISSOD, around.
explanation.definitionFit: A dossier is a collection of documents on one subject, an official file.

clue.text: Poet fashionable, holding appeal

indicators.note: the fashionable word holds the following letters inside it

parts.note: swell is dated slang for smart or fashionable
it is slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: A stylish poet is credited with charm.
explanation.definitionFit: Edith Sitwell was an English poet, as were her brothers Osbert and Sacheverell.

clue.text: Pretentiousness, taking fashionable mode of transport

indicators.note: the first word takes on the following one at its end

parts.note: putting on airs is behaving pretentiously
hip means fashionable

explanation.surface: A showy sort chooses a trendy way to travel.
explanation.definitionFit: An airship is a lighter-than-air craft, a dirigible used to travel.

clue.text: In position, ready to greet press release

definitions.meaning: with a hand extended, as for a handshake
a statement given to the press

explanation.definitionFit: A hand held out is ready to shake, and a handout is a statement issued to the media.

clue.text: Knock head on cask

definitions.meaning: to strike with the head, as a goat does
a large barrel for wine or beer

explanation.definitionFit: A goat strikes with its head, and the word also names a large barrel for ale or wine.

clue.text: Lady of rank, say, introduced to tramp

indicators.note: the example letters are put into the tramp word

parts.note: bum is slang for a tramp or vagrant
eg, for example, is what say means here

explanation.surface: A noblewoman, for instance, is presented to a vagrant.
explanation.definitionFit: A begum is a Muslim woman of high rank in South Asia.

clue.text: Tea chap wanted — no wine

parts.note: char is British slang for tea
a don is a gentleman or fellow, as in Spanish Don
nay means no

explanation.surface: Someone wants tea from a fellow, refusing wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wanted' is a link word joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Chardonnay is a white wine grape and the dry white made from it.

clue.text: In hearing, court orders establishment of wealth

indicators.note: the clue points to what is heard, a word said out loud

parts.note: writs are written orders issued by a court

explanation.surface: At a hearing, a judge's orders establish someone's riches.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ritz is a luxury London hotel, a byword for wealth.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous luxury hotel is an establishment associated with the rich.

clue.text: Bunch of documents I needed for dry course

parts.note: a wad is a thick bundle of papers

explanation.surface: A stack of papers and I are required for a course.
explanation.definitionFit: A wadi is a riverbed that stays dry except in the rainy season.

clue.text: Small bomb finally dropped by a Commonwealth country

indicators.note: the last letter of the bomb word is left off

parts.note: a grenade is a small bomb thrown by hand

explanation.surface: A small explosive was dropped on a Commonwealth nation.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface recalls the 1983 US invasion of the Caribbean island.
explanation.definitionFit: The Caribbean island nation is a member of the Commonwealth.

clue.text: Old master gets to draw game

parts.note: a tie is a drawn game
polo is a sport played on horseback

explanation.surface: An old master gets to sketch a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo was an eighteenth-century Venetian painter, a classic master.

clue.text: Felt cutter perhaps was a tiny distance ahead of big ship

indicators.note: the distance word goes in front of the ship word

parts.note: a mil is a thousandth of an inch
a liner is a large passenger ship

explanation.surface: Something that slices felt was just in front of an ocean liner.
explanation.definitionFit: A hatmaker cuts felt to shape hats, so is plausibly a cutter of felt.

clue.text: Poor result for some counties

indicators.note: poor, as in badly made, means the letters of the next word are reformed

explanation.surface: A disappointing outcome for certain counties.
explanation.walkthrough: Ulster is the northern Irish province of nine counties.
explanation.definitionFit: The province of nine counties in the north of Ireland comprises several shires.
